promotionCandidates.title: Converge campaign and note authorization caller shapes

evidence.note: The canonical AuthzCallerContext contract says authorization helpers take one caller shape carrying userId and optional logger together.
assertCampaignMember still splits userId and logContext into separate positional parameters; assertCampaignDm repeats the shape at lines 72-77.
loadNoteForMutation likewise accepts userId and AuthzLogContext separately instead of the canonical caller object.

promotionCandidates.problem: The repository declares AuthzCallerContext as the single authorization-boundary caller shape, but campaign and note guards still split identity from logging context. Their large caller surface must repeatedly assemble positional fields, leaving the compiler-bound contract inconsistent and increasing signature-change and omission risk.
promotionCandidates.proposedDirection: Move assertCampaignMember, assertCampaignDm, and loadNoteForMutation to `(prisma, scopeId, caller: AuthzCallerContext)`, updating each helper and all callers atomically while preserving one-log-per-boundary and NOT_FOUND normalization semantics.
